title: NORD-10 synchronous modem card 2A50: modem (V.24) lines

sources.document: NORD-10 drawings, sheet 2A50 SYNCHRONOUS MODEM BUFFER 1050 (1973), as read pin by pin in this repository (sheets/nord-10/2A50-sync-modem-buffer-1050.rsc, docs/2A50-reading.md)
sources.note: The names the card drawing uses (LEV10, IOXE, MC ...) differ from the backplane names (BINT10, BIOXE, BMCL ...); the pin numbers match.

sources.document: ND-06.008.01 NORD-10/S Reference Manual, Revision A
sources.note: Sections 3.3 (IOX), IDENT instruction, 4.1 (Input/Output hardware) and 4.1.3 (vectored interrupt identification). It refers to the NORD-10 Input/Output manual ND-06.004 for signal levels, definitions and timing; that manual was NOT found on this machine.

name.note: The drawing marks these pins with circled numbers like the bus pins; which connector (card edge, backplane cable socket or a separate front plug) is not stated in any document found.

pinNumbering.value: card pin number (circled) with the V.24 / modem plug pin number in brackets

pinsConfidence: read (2A50 sheet nets; direction read from line receivers 13A/15A and drivers 17A/19A)

groundAndOthers.note: V.24 pins 1 and 7 (grounds) are not drawn with numbers on 2A50; 2A50 ties edge pins 80, 82, 84, 86, 94 to ground.
